# Contract: Administration Panel

*Generated by spec-writer. Hand edits are overwritten on regeneration.*

## Prerequisites

These conditions describe the environment in which items in this
contract are exercised. Producing them is part of the feature's
deliverable, alongside the implementation itself — a contract whose
prerequisites are not yet satisfied is not failing, it is still being
built. Once the feature is delivered, any missing condition halts item
execution until it is restored.

**Runtime services:**
- the backend HTTP service (`apps/backend`) is running, migrated against its PostgreSQL database, and reachable
- the `apps/web` Next.js application is running (dev server or production build) and reachable by a browser, with its proxy Route Handlers able to reach the backend service
- a browser (or browser-automation engine) is available to drive UI and E2E items

**Persistent state:**
- an admin user exists with name "Existing Admin", email "admin@example.com", password "ValidPass123", is_admin=true, not suspended. Used by: every item in this contract as the authenticated admin actor, except API-GATE-01, API-GATE-02, and UI-GATE-01 (which exercise non-admin/unauthenticated access), and except as the deletion target in API-DELETE-03 and API-DELETE-04.
- a user exists with name "Existing User", email "existing@example.com", password "ValidPass123" (the same fixture account established by the Authentication System feature), not suspended, not an admin. Used by: API-GATE-01, UI-GATE-01, API-LIST-01, API-LIST-03, UI-USERS-01.
- a second admin exists with name "Second Admin", email "second-admin@example.com", password "ValidPass123", is_admin=true, not suspended — present only for the scenario where a self-delete attempt must be distinguished from a last-admin attempt. Used by: API-DELETE-03.
- a user exists with name "Suspend Target", email "suspend-target@example.com", password "ValidPass123", not suspended, not an admin, currently logged in with an active session. Used by: API-SUSPEND-01, API-SUSPEND-02, API-REACTIVATE-01, API-LIST-04, UI-SUSPEND-01, E2E-SUSPEND-01.
- a user exists with name "Delete Target", email "delete-target@example.com", password "ValidPass123", not suspended, not an admin, owning two videos: "Delete Target Clip A" (status `ready`, with a stored video file and a stored thumbnail file on disk) and "Delete Target Clip B" (status `validating`, with a stored video file only). Used by: API-OVERVIEW-01, API-DELETE-01, API-DELETE-02, API-LIST-04, UI-DELETE-01, UI-DELETE-02, UI-DELETE-03, E2E-DELETE-01.
- a user exists with name "Searchable Sam", email "searchable.sam@example.com", not suspended, not an admin. Used by: API-LIST-02, UI-USERS-02.
- 50 additional users exist beyond the fixtures above, named "Bulk User 001" through "Bulk User 050" with emails `bulk-user-001@example.com` through `bulk-user-050@example.com`, none suspended, none admin, none owning videos — enough that the full user list totals 55 accounts, forcing a second page at the fixed 50-per-page size. Used by: API-LIST-05, API-LIST-06, UI-USERS-04.

**Static inputs:**
- `video-samples/tiny-valid.mp4` — the same small (a few seconds, well under 1MB) valid MP4 fixture established by the Video Upload feature; its content backs both of "Delete Target"'s stored video files, so their removal is directly verifiable. Used by: API-DELETE-01, E2E-DELETE-01.

**Configuration:**
- the frontend recognizes a cookie named `videomax_session` (any non-empty value) as an "authenticated visitor" signal, per the Authentication System feature. Used by: every UI and E2E item.
- the backend's session-signing key is configured and stable for the duration of a run. Used by: every item (all resolve a session to authenticate the acting admin, where one is required).
- the frontend's internal backend base URL is configured and points at the running backend service. Used by: every UI and E2E item, since all of them traverse the proxy.
- the backend's local-disk storage root is configured and points at a writable directory for the duration of a run. Used by: API-DELETE-01, E2E-DELETE-01.
- the admin user list's page size is a fixed server-side value of 50 and is not client-configurable. Used by: API-LIST-05, API-LIST-06, UI-USERS-04.

## Quality gates

Each gate must pass for the feature to be considered ready.

- **Backend architecture audit** — `npm run gates` — the consolidated backend check (TypeScript compiles with no errors, ESLint reports no errors, dependency-cruiser reports no forbidden cross-layer imports, the structural architecture check passes, madge reports no circular imports, knip reports no orphaned files/exports) succeeds as a whole.
- **Backend tests** — `npm run test --workspace apps/backend` — the Vitest suite (domain, use case, and handler tests) passes.
- **Backend build** — `npm run build --workspace apps/backend` — the TypeScript production build completes without errors.
- **Frontend lint** — `npm run lint --workspace apps/web` — ESLint reports no errors across the frontend app.
- **Frontend typecheck** — `npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web` — TypeScript compiles with no type errors (`tsc --noEmit`).
- **Frontend unit/component tests** — `npm run test --workspace apps/web` — the Vitest + React Testing Library suite passes.
- **Frontend end-to-end tests** — `npm run test:e2e --workspace apps/web` — the Playwright suite passes against a running build.
- **Frontend build** — `npm run build --workspace apps/web` — the Next.js production build completes without errors.

## Coverage Manifest

| PRD Acceptance Criterion | Covered by |
|---|---|
| Only users with the `is_admin` flag can access `/admin`; non-admins receive 404 | API-GATE-01, API-GATE-02, UI-GATE-01 |
| `/admin` shows total registered users and total videos | API-OVERVIEW-01, UI-DASH-01 |
| `/admin/users` lists every user with name, email, registration date, last login, and video count | API-LIST-01, UI-USERS-01 |
| Admin can search the user list by name or email substring, sort by any column, and paginate at 50 per page | API-LIST-02, API-LIST-03, API-LIST-04, API-LIST-05, API-LIST-06, UI-USERS-02, UI-USERS-03, UI-USERS-04 |
| Admin can suspend a user; suspended users cannot log in and active sessions are invalidated | API-SUSPEND-01, API-SUSPEND-02, UI-SUSPEND-01, E2E-SUSPEND-01 |
| Admin can reactivate a suspended user | API-REACTIVATE-01 |
| Admin can delete a user only after typing the user's email in the confirmation modal; deletion cascades to all videos, thumbnails, transcriptions, summaries, folders, and tags | API-DELETE-01, API-DELETE-02, UI-DELETE-01, UI-DELETE-02, UI-DELETE-03, E2E-DELETE-01 |
| Admin cannot suspend or delete their own account | API-SUSPEND-03, API-DELETE-03 |
| The system always keeps at least one admin account (the last admin cannot be deleted) | API-DELETE-04 |
| Video records provided by upload (F03) are aggregated into the total-videos metric on `/admin` and into the per-user video count on `/admin/users` (F12) | API-OVERVIEW-01, API-LIST-01 |

## HTTP API

**Verification mode:** Send an HTTP request to the running backend service; assert response status, headers, body, and any direct persisted side-effect.

### Access gating

**Common given:** the backend is running with default configuration.

#### `API-GATE-01` — a non-admin authenticated caller gets a masked 404
- given: (default), and "Existing User" is authenticated
- when: GET /admin/overview
- then:
  - response is `404` with `code: "NOT_FOUND"`

#### `API-GATE-02` — an unauthenticated caller gets the identical masked 404
- given: (default), and no token is presented
- when: GET /admin/overview
- then:
  - response is `404` with `code: "NOT_FOUND"`
  - the response body is indistinguishable in shape from `API-GATE-01`'s

### Overview

**Common given:** the backend is running with default configuration; "Existing Admin" is authenticated.

#### `API-OVERVIEW-01` — dashboard totals reflect real data
- given: (default)
- when: GET /admin/overview
- then:
  - response is `200` with body `{ totalUsers, totalVideos }`, both numbers
  - `totalUsers` equals the `total` field a subsequent GET /admin/users (page 1) returns
  - `totalVideos` is at least 2 (the two videos owned by "Delete Target")

### List

**Common given:** the backend is running with default configuration; "Existing Admin" is authenticated.

#### `API-LIST-01` — lists users with full admin metadata
- given: (default)
- when: GET /admin/users?search=Existing%20User
- then:
  - response is `200` and `items` includes exactly one entry `{ id, name: "Existing User", email: "existing@example.com", createdAt, lastLoginAt, videoCount, isSuspended: false, isAdmin: false }`

#### `API-LIST-02` — search matches by name or email substring
- given: (default)
- when: GET /admin/users?search=searchable
- then:
  - response is `200` with `items` containing exactly the "Searchable Sam" entry

#### `API-LIST-03` — sort by name ascending
- given: (default)
- when: GET /admin/users?search=Existing&sortBy=name&sortDir=asc
- then:
  - response is `200` with `items` ordered by name: "Existing Admin", "Existing User"

#### `API-LIST-04` — sort by video count descending
- given: (default)
- when: GET /admin/users?search=Target&sortBy=videoCount&sortDir=desc
- then:
  - response is `200` with `items` ordered: "Delete Target" (videoCount 2), "Suspend Target" (videoCount 0)

#### `API-LIST-05` — page 1 is capped at 50 with the correct total
- given: (default), and the 50 bulk-user fixtures exist alongside every named fixture (55 total users)
- when: GET /admin/users (page 1, default sort)
- then:
  - response is `200` with `pageSize: 50`, `items.length` is `50`, and `total` is `55`

#### `API-LIST-06` — page 2 returns the remainder
- given: (default), and the 50 bulk-user fixtures exist alongside every named fixture (55 total users)
- when: GET /admin/users?page=2
- then:
  - response is `200` with `items.length` is `5`

### Suspend

**Common given:** the backend is running with default configuration; "Existing Admin" is authenticated; "Suspend Target" is not suspended and holds an active session.

#### `API-SUSPEND-01` — happy path invalidates the target's active session
- given: (default)
- when: POST /admin/users/{id of "Suspend Target"}/suspend
- then:
  - response is `200` with body `{ id, isSuspended: true }`
  - the user is persisted as suspended
  - a subsequent authenticated request using "Suspend Target"'s previously active session token is rejected

#### `API-SUSPEND-02` — a suspended user is blocked at login with the exact message
- given: (default), and "Suspend Target" has already been suspended by an admin
- when: POST /auth/login with "Suspend Target"'s credentials
- then:
  - response is `403` with `code: "ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED"` and message "This account has been suspended"
  - no session is issued

#### `API-SUSPEND-03` — an admin cannot suspend their own account
- given: (default)
- when: POST /admin/users/{id of "Existing Admin"}/suspend
- then:
  - response is `403` with `code: "FORBIDDEN"` and message "You cannot suspend or delete your own admin account"
  - "Existing Admin" is persisted as not suspended

### Reactivate

**Common given:** the backend is running with default configuration; "Existing Admin" is authenticated; "Suspend Target" has already been suspended.

#### `API-REACTIVATE-01` — happy path restores login capability
- given: (default)
- when: POST /admin/users/{id of "Suspend Target"}/reactivate
- then:
  - response is `200` with body `{ id, isSuspended: false }`
  - a subsequent POST /auth/login with "Suspend Target"'s credentials succeeds

### Delete

**Common given:** the backend is running with default configuration; "Existing Admin" is authenticated.

#### `API-DELETE-01` — happy path cascades to sessions, videos, and files
- given: (default), and "Delete Target" owns its two fixture videos with their stored files
- when: DELETE /admin/users/{id of "Delete Target"} with body `{ confirmEmail: "delete-target@example.com" }`
- then:
  - response is `204`
  - a subsequent admin user-list search for "Delete Target" returns zero results
  - both of "Delete Target"'s stored video files and its stored thumbnail file no longer exist on disk
  - any session previously belonging to "Delete Target" no longer resolves

#### `API-DELETE-02` — wrong confirmation email is rejected
- given: (default), and "Delete Target" still exists
- when: DELETE /admin/users/{id of "Delete Target"} with body `{ confirmEmail: "wrong@example.com" }`
- then:
  - response is `422` with `code: "EMAIL_CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH"`
  - "Delete Target" is still persisted, unchanged

#### `API-DELETE-03` — an admin cannot delete their own account while another admin exists
- given: (default), and "Second Admin" also exists as a second admin account
- when: DELETE /admin/users/{id of "Existing Admin"} with body `{ confirmEmail: "admin@example.com" }`
- then:
  - response is `403` with `code: "FORBIDDEN"` and message "You cannot suspend or delete your own admin account"
  - "Existing Admin" is still persisted

#### `API-DELETE-04` — the sole remaining admin cannot be deleted
- given: (default), and "Existing Admin" is the only admin account in the system
- when: DELETE /admin/users/{id of "Existing Admin"} with body `{ confirmEmail: "admin@example.com" }`
- then:
  - response is `409` with `code: "LAST_ADMIN_CANNOT_BE_DELETED"`
  - "Existing Admin" is still persisted

## UI

**Verification mode:** Render the surface, drive it with user-like inputs (clicks, typing); assert observable surface state (DOM, visible text, timing, navigation).

### Access gating

#### `UI-GATE-01` — a logged-in non-admin visiting /admin sees the app's 404 page
- given: "Existing User" is logged in (a valid `videomax_session` cookie, reached through `/login`)
- when: navigate to `/admin`
- then:
  - the rendered page is the application's not-found page, not the admin dashboard
  - no "Dashboard"/"Users" admin navigation is present anywhere on the page

### Dashboard

**Common given:** "Existing Admin" is logged in and on `/admin`.

#### `UI-DASH-01` — the dashboard renders both metric cards
- given: (default)
- when: the page loads
- then:
  - a card shows the total registered users count
  - a card shows the total videos count

### Users table

**Common given:** "Existing Admin" is logged in and on `/admin/users`.

#### `UI-USERS-01` — the table renders every fixture user's columns
- given: (default)
- when: the page loads
- then:
  - a row for "Existing User" shows its name, email, registration date, last-login readout, and video count
  - a row exists for "Existing Admin" as well

#### `UI-USERS-02` — the search box filters the table
- given: (default)
- when: type "searchable" into the search input
- then:
  - only the "Searchable Sam" row remains visible

#### `UI-USERS-03` — clicking a column header sorts the table
- given: (default), and the search box is filtered to "Target" (matching "Delete Target" and "Suspend Target" only)
- when: click the "Video count" column header
- then:
  - "Delete Target" (2 videos) is now the first of the two visible rows

#### `UI-USERS-04` — pagination moves to a second page
- given: (default), and the 50 bulk-user fixtures exist
- when: click the "next page" control
- then:
  - the table now renders the remaining users that did not fit on page 1
  - the page indicator reads page 2

### Suspend

**Common given:** "Existing Admin" is logged in and on `/admin/users`; "Suspend Target" is not suspended.

#### `UI-SUSPEND-01` — suspending updates the row's status and available action
- given: (default)
- when: on "Suspend Target"'s row, click "Suspend"
- then:
  - the row's status badge now reads "Suspended"
  - the row's action is now "Reactivate" in place of "Suspend"

### Delete

**Common given:** "Existing Admin" is logged in and on `/admin/users`; "Delete Target" exists.

#### `UI-DELETE-01` — a mismatched typed email keeps the Delete button disabled
- given: (default)
- when: on "Delete Target"'s row, open the delete confirmation modal and type "wrong@example.com"
- then:
  - the modal's Delete button remains disabled

#### `UI-DELETE-02` — the exact typed email enables the Delete button
- given: (default), and the delete confirmation modal for "Delete Target" is open
- when: clear the field and type "delete-target@example.com"
- then:
  - the modal's Delete button becomes enabled

#### `UI-DELETE-03` — confirming deletion removes the row
- given: (default)
- when: open the delete confirmation modal, type "delete-target@example.com", and click Delete
- then:
  - the modal closes
  - "Delete Target"'s row is no longer present in the table

## E2E

**Verification mode:** Run the full system (frontend + backend + database); drive through a real browser; assert cross-stack behavior.

### Suspend

#### `E2E-SUSPEND-01` — suspending through the admin UI blocks a real login attempt
- given: "Existing Admin" is logged in on `/admin/users`; "Suspend Target" is not suspended
- when: suspend "Suspend Target" through the UI, then in a separate browser context attempt to log in as "Suspend Target" with its correct credentials
- then:
  - the login attempt shows "This account has been suspended"
  - the login page does not navigate to `/app`

### Delete

#### `E2E-DELETE-01` — deleting through the admin UI persists and removes files
- given: "Existing Admin" is logged in on `/admin/users`; "Delete Target" owns its two fixture videos with stored files
- when: delete "Delete Target" through the UI (typing its exact email to confirm), then reload the browser on `/admin/users`
- then:
  - after reload, no row exists for "Delete Target"
  - no user row exists in the database with "Delete Target"'s id
  - both of "Delete Target"'s stored video files and its stored thumbnail file no longer exist on disk
